response.sql: WITH t AS (SELECT production_type_code, AVG(unit_price) AS a FROM Products GROUP BY production_type_code HAVING AVG(unit_price) IS NOT NULL), o AS (SELECT AVG(unit_price) AS v FROM Products), k AS (SELECT t.production_type_code, t.a FROM t JOIN o ON t.a > o.v), m AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS v FROM k), f AS (SELECT k.a FROM k JOIN m ON k.a > m.v) SELECT AVG(f.a) AS avg_type_price, AVG(f.a - o.v) AS avg_above_overall, AVG(f.a - m.v) AS avg_above_kept_mean FROM f CROSS JOIN o CROSS JOIN m

assumptions.assumption: The overall average price is the average of unit_price across all Products rows with a non-null price. It is not the mean of the type averages.
Types whose prices are all NULL have no average and are dropped.
If no type passes a filter, the query returns one row of NULLs.
